task.title: Harden freelancer verification workflow (unsuspend + safe actions)
task.description: Implement explicit 'unsuspend' admin action and harden the verification flow: backend 'unsuspend' action and API, frontend Admin Dashboard 'Unsuspend' button with confirmation and optional note, unit and integration tests, and ensure audit logging. Skip observability and KPI automation since those are already present.
task.command: echo 'design: api schema + tests for unsuspend verification flow'

result.stdout: start: implement unsuspend and verification hardening

spec.goal: Harden freelancer verification workflow by adding an explicit 'unsuspend' admin action, validating permissions, state transitions, and tests.

api_schema.auth: Cookie or token-based session; actor must have role 'admin' and permission 'admin.users.manage' (or equivalent).

200.description: User unsuspended; returns updated user object

checks: actor role == 'admin' or has explicit superuser flag

transitions.guards: verify action must not implicitly unsuspend; unsuspend must be explicit when current==suspended

server_side: Ensure target user exists and is not a system/service account
Enforce idempotence: repeated unsuspend returns 200 and no duplicate audit log entries if already verified
safety: Require admin role and permission check as primary gate
Log full audit record: actor_id, target_id, action, before_state, after_state, reason, timestamp, hash_chain
Rate-limit or require approval in high-risk orgs (optional, documented)

assertions: After unsuspend: verification_status == 'verified' and is_active == True
A FinancialAuditLog or UserAudit entry exists with expected before/after state
Endpoint returns 400 if target not suspended

files_to_change: backend/apps/adminpanel/services.py -> add handling for 'unsuspend' or new 'unsuspend_user' function
backend/apps/adminpanel/views.py -> add route POST /admin/users/{id}/unsuspend/ mapping to service
backend/apps/adminpanel/tests.py -> add unit tests described above
backend/apps/accounts/serializers.py -> ensure serializer exposes verification_status, rejection_reason, is_active for response
frontend/app/[locale]/admin/page.tsx -> add 'Unsuspend' button in user row with confirmation dialog and optional note (i18n copy)
backend/common/models.py or backend/apps/payments/models.py -> audit/logging hook already exists; reuse _build_hash_chain for audit record
spec.developer_notes: Keep changes minimal and additive. Reuse existing verify_user service if practical by adding a dedicated 'unsuspend' branch rather than overloading 'verify'. Ensure tests clean caches where relevant. Follow existing Conventional Commit style for commits.

manual_steps: Run migrations if models changed: python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate
